mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 78 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Area High School landmark. Please be aware of an air quality index of 51. The moon is in its first quarter, and early tomorrow at 3:23 AM, the space station will be visible, rising in the south over Belleville and tracking toward the east over Fitchburg, staying low on the horizon. Tonight, we expect an overnight low of 62 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The city is currently seeking an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects, with an application deadline of September 20. Additionally, the city has updated sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure self-supporting infrastructure maintenance, which may impact quarterly bills.

There is plenty happening today, including the User Group Meeting at Epic, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Baileys Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a noteworthy call from Friday, August 15, an officer performed a traffic stop on a 29-year-old Verona man who was subsequently arrested for an O W I, second offence, along with several other traffic citations.
Stop by Culvers today to enjoy the Chocolate Heath Crunch flavor of the day before they close at 10 PM.
